phase3_findings.description: docs/external/rule-sets.md line 99 says serve and validate both print a warning for an unconfirmed set; serve emits it through the sqllens.rule_sets logger before logging is configured.

docs/external/rule-sets.md line 125 claims the decimal-string equivalence holds everywhere, which is false of the file itself, and line 145 tells the operator to restart although the same sentence says the check retries on the next request.

The runner call orders in docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md lines 185 and 191, docs/internal/agent/factory.md line 87 and docs/internal/database-connectors/row-level-security.md line 209 omit the two new runners.
The AGENTS.md architecture tree gains no entry for src/sqllens/rule_sets.py or src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py.
src/sqllens/cli.py line 167 separates _unconfirmed_rule_sets from the preceding definition with one blank line instead of two.

src/sqllens/cli.py lines 99-119: _rule_set_file_configured swallows OSError, UnicodeDecodeError and TOMLDecodeError and answers False with no log record, so the operator never learns that verify-memory does not support rule sets in the case the branch exists for.

src/sqllens/server.py lines 243-252 discard the whole of _meta at debug level when a future SDK stops exposing model_fields_set; with a rule-set file every request would then be refused with nothing above debug to explain it, unlike the sibling branch, which warns.

src/sqllens/rule_sets.py lines 234-358 keep several invariants at call sites rather than in the types: the indexed-file docstring, the public mutable confirmed latch that preflight writes without the lock, the unbounded rule_sets list, and the unconstrained RuleSetSelection.
src/sqllens/safety/rule_sets.py lines 470-472 rebuild the refusal behind its own constructor, so a future stateful subclass would be re-raised half-built.
src/sqllens/agent/factory.py lines 91-105: the rule-set user resolver falls back to the shared built-in user with no log record when no selection is published.

src/sqllens/agent/core/system_prompt/default.py lines 61-64 and docs/internal/database-connectors/rule-sets.md line 57 state both prompt rules unconditionally, without the dialect and base-prompt conditions that decide them.
tests/connectors/test_rule_sets_mysql.py line 8 describes the example set as listing a predicate column the shared example lacks.
docs/internal/database-connectors/rule-sets.md line 3 records a freshness marker five commits behind the branch head.
docs/external/configuration.md line 234 still frames row-rule blocks as unlike other sections in rejecting unknown keys.
No test covers that list_data_sources answers a call carrying no request metadata while a rule-set file is configured, nor that the bundle manifest gains no rule-set entry.
